unscopedCss.scope: Every stylesheet in the current Macro manifest

contract.text: 250 UTF-16 units; emoji appends to the end, checks full length and does not replace selection
contract.save: O -> N and trigger document.body.click() disarm Save. A later nonempty draft change arms it; clearing does not disarm it. Cancel/outside/close restore item.Text. Only popup Save updates the action.
contract.placement: fixed x=trigger.left, y=trigger.bottom+10; if y+250 > innerHeight then y=trigger.top-250; scroll repositions after 150ms debounce and hides when trigger.top+8 leaves item_editor
contract.popup: Single 500ms linear opacity wrapper at top:184px; immediate visibility. Tooltip opacity is 300ms linear with no delay.
quirks: Unknown Windows version retains five cat glyphs; only literal 11 filters them
clear search changes input only; resetEmoji is a no-op and filtered results remain until a later input change
category title uses unscoped emoji_popup_main_label; variant children use unscoped emoji_popup_main_item; scoped CSS does not match them
